description:
Check the published site against Layero's anti-phishing rules
    (https://layero.ru/rules): collecting passwords, card details or wallet
    recovery phrases of another service, fake security warnings, vote and
    prize lures that send visitors to another domain.

    Checks what a visitor sees at the project address — the home page and its
    own scripts. `violations` is empty when nothing matches. `publish_site`
    and `site_status` run the same check after a deploy and add
    `rules_warnings` only when something matches, so a separate call is needed
    only when the user asks.

project.description: The project: its slug (`my-site`) or id, as listed by `my_projects`. The site address works too (`https://clear-garden-vypm.layero.app` or just `clear-garden-vypm`) — note that the address host is NOT always the slug.
